questions.explanation: Generics let one implementation work for many types with compile-time type safety.

questions.prompt: A generic method's type parameter is:
options: Chosen by the caller at compile time
questions.explanation: The caller (or the compiler) supplies the type for T.

questions.prompt: where T : struct means T must be:
questions.explanation: struct restricts T to value types like int, bool, DateTime.
A generic method can return its own type parameter T.

questions.prompt: A generic class is parameterized by a _____ parameter.
questions.template: A generic class is parameterized by a _____ parameter.

Each instantiation of a generic class is a distinct type.
